set.body: Found by S8.7 (p0-s87). No wire request evaluates a ReportingSpec over a run, so reporting edits change the document while the summary keeps its served means and n, and the fake serves one grouping for every spec. eyes4s-results has the evaluation (UI-C). Add a protocol request report(run, spec) served by the library (fake and real backend), returning the cells, n, the dropped-cell preview, and the outside-window filter count, each with a StudioRef. Bump the protocol minor after 1.9. Blocks the S8.7 summary reflecting edits.
set.title: Studio protocol: evaluate a ReportingSpec over a run (report(run, spec))
